model_note: equidistant+cubic about the optical axis, fixed alt-az camera; binned 2028x1520 grid (load_binned)
fit_method: astro-science #1107 scratch/allcam/fithq16.py: astrometry.net .corr matches, least squares; then iterated against Hipparcos V<7.5 on the frame's detections
stars_note: Hipparcos V<6.5 (VizieR I/239, hip75-allsky.npy), 1702 stars, in the declination band -18.8..6.9 that HQ16's fixed field sweeps through a night (all RA). Cut chosen by detection within 3 px on the fit frame (60 s sub, 11-13 01:01 UTC): fainter stars are mostly undetected, and derot-sky refine takes the brightest pixel within 3 px of EVERY listed star, so they would add noise. astro-science 2026-11-23, scratch/allcam/hq16stars.py.
